A quiet gem
Mar 2026 • Couples
Excellent peaceful charismatic little joint. Down a hidden alley and up three flights but that makes it all the better up there. Quite interesting looking cafe/restaurant. Best part is they had good music and you’ll know it soon as you go in cos it’s not that horrible viet pop rubbish everywhere else.
Anyway the food is tasty, coffee good, service is lovely and the seating is better than everywhere else.
Much more to the place but you’ll see when you get there.
If you want a break from the noisy street cafes this is for you.

Put this hidden gem on your must visit when in Saigon list
Jun 2025 • Couples
This hidden little gem should be on every travellers list. Hidden down an ally and up three levels you will walk into this little
oasis. Delivering in style charm and old school Saigon vibe with cool background music to add to the ambience. Now the food, it was sensational traditional food a taste sensation. One of the best meals we had in Vietnam
Mar 2025 • Couples
The food in Vietnam can sometimes be.... challenging :) The Old Compass Cafe was without doubt one of the best meals we had during our two week visit. Unambiguously Vietnamese food but without any challenging aspects, and thoroughly enjoyable.

We had someone show us the way to the cafe, and tbh I think I would find it difficult to locate on my own. Suffice to say if you think you're in the wrong place you're probably on the right track, so just keep going. Once there, the vibe is modern and eclectic, and the food is great.
